Class LeaderboardDTO

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.DTO.LeaderboardDTO
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class LeaderboardDTO extends Object implements Serializable
A Data Transfer Object (DTO) containing the finalized session leaderboard and tiebreaker results.

This class encapsulates the final standings of a specific game session, mapping each participating player to their respective scoring metrics. It explicitly tracks whether the match concluded in an absolute tie via the isSharedVictory flag, allowing the client interface to render custom celebration or victory banners accordingly.

To ensure architectural stability across the network layer, the underlying list structure is wrapped inside an unmodifiable collection upon creation.

    • LeaderboardDTO

      public LeaderboardDTO(List<PlayerRankDTO> rankings, boolean isSharedVictory)
      Constructs an immutable LeaderboardDTO instance with the provided player rankings and victory status flag.

      The input list is automatically decorated with Collections.unmodifiableList(List) to safeguard the immutable design of data transfer nodes across client threads.

      Parameters:
      rankings - the sorted List of PlayerRankDTO entries; must not be null
      isSharedVictory - true if the game rules resolved into a joint first-place tie; false if a single distinct winner was declared
